title: FinVision: Multimodal AI for Visualizing Financial Narratives
abstract: arXiv:2611.19956v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Financial narratives contain rich information about firms' performance and business conditions. Conventional text analysis often summarizes this information into numerical representations, which may not fully preserve the dynamic structure described in the narrative. In this study, we develop FinVision, a domain-specific multimodal generative model that translates financial narratives into visual representations of contemporaneous market dynamics. Using 87,940 paired observations of Management Discussion and Analysis (MD&A) disclosures and stock price charts, FinVision learns the average relationship between a firm's narrative account of a fiscal year and its stock-price dynamics over the same period. Given an MD&A alone, the trained model generates a text-implied stock chart, extending financial text analysis beyond numerical representations toward text-to-visual generation. translated_title: FinVision：用于可视化金融叙述的多模态人工智能
translated_abstract: 金融叙述中包含关于公司业绩和经营状况的丰富信息。传统的文本分析通常将这些信息总结为数值表示，这可能无法完全保留叙述中所描述的动态结构。在本研究中，我们开发了FinVision，这是一个面向金融领域的多模态生成模型，能够将金融叙述转换为同期市场动态的视觉表示。利用87,940对管理层讨论与分析（MD&A）披露与股票价格图表的配对观测数据，FinVision学习了公司对某一财年的叙述性描述与同期股价动态之间的平均关系。仅给定一份MD&A文本，训练好的模型即可生成由文本隐含的股票图表，将金融文本分析从数值表示拓展至文本到视觉的生成。我们通过两种方式对FinVision进行验证。首先，留出测试表…（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出FinVision，一个领域专用的多模态生成模型，仅凭公司年报中的管理层讨论与分析（MD&A）文本即可生成反映同期股价动态的隐含股票图表，将金融文本分析从数值表示拓展到文本到视觉的生成。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces FinVision, a domain-specific multimodal generative model that generates text-implied stock price charts solely from MD&A disclosures, extending financial text analysis from numerical representations toward text-to-visual generation.
